summary: Turns an already-built index (plus the co-change sidecar and note anchors handed in by the caller) into the compact payload `coldstart graph` draws. Two things here are load-bearing and were both arrived at by getting them wrong: directory bands are chosen ADAPTIVELY by assignClusters (split any band over 13% one segment deeper, then fold slivers into a terminal 'other' that is itself allowed to stay small), because a fixed depth-2 cut put 1093 of arches's 1615 files in one band; and the named verbs on call edges come from aggregating index.symbolEdges per FILE PAIR, because every edge in index.edges is a plain import and carries no verb. This module deliberately loads nothing — no index build, no notebook read — so it stays a pure function that tests can drive.
